channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Launch your own AI hotspot news site: hands-on with AIHOT
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AIHOT (KKKKhazix/AIHOT, MIT) is the open-source engine behind aihot.news — a self-hosted framework that ingests six source types, scores every story twice with an LLM, clusters duplicates into events, ranks them by heat, and publishes a daily digest. Nearly 6,700 GitHub stars in under two weeks.

item.title: Anthropic launches the Cyber Mission: on-site engineers for critical infrastructure, free AI scans for open source
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic on Thursday launched the Anthropic Cyber Mission, a long-term push to aim frontier AI at cybersecurity's least-resourced defenders: the operators of power grids and water systems get the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program with 11 founding partners, while open-source projects get OSS Scanner — free, AI-powered vulnerability scans with proof-of-concept exploits attached.

item.title: NVIDIA leads a $2.4B tech pledge to Trump's 'Golden Age of Science' summit — plus $159M in new DOE awards
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At the White House 'Science: A New Golden Age' summit, eleven tech companies pledged $2.4 billion in AI tools and compute credits to the Genesis Mission — and DOE announced $159 million in new awards to put 'super intelligence' to work across federal labs.

item.title: Anthropic bans needless cruelty toward Claude: its 2026 usage policy also tightens deception, weapons, and surveillance rules
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic's annual Usage Policy update adds a ban on 'sustained and needless' cruelty toward Claude, consolidates rules against deceptive campaigns, and clarifies prohibitions on weapons software, surveillance, and autonomous hardware. Effective November 12.

item.title: Apple says “Welcome home”: an October 13 smart-home event built around the new Siri AI
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Apple’s marketing chief teased an October 13 “Welcome home” event on Thursday, with media invited to an “Apple Experience” in New York — where the long-delayed smart home hub, a refreshed HomePod mini and a new Apple TV 4K are all expected to run the new Siri AI.

item.title: US suspends Microsoft, Adobe from the green-card labor program: the PERM freeze rattling AI hiring
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: On Thursday, Vice President JD Vance and Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling suspended Microsoft, Adobe and six major IT outsourcers from the PERM labor-certification program — freezing the employer-sponsored green-card path at some of the largest corporate sponsors of employment-based green cards, amid active federal fraud investigations.

item.title: Scality launches AI Inference Factory: an open-code stack for on-prem AI inference — KV cache from object storage, 14x faster than recompute
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Scality announced Thursday the availability of its AI Inference Factory, a supported open-code stack for running AI inference on enterprise-owned infrastructure — serving KV cache from object storage over RDMA at near-GPU-memory latency, 14x faster than recompute in its tests.

item.title: Manus raises $500M in first round since Beijing killed Meta's $2B takeover
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Butterfly Effect, the parent company of AI agent startup Manus, announced Thursday it has raised more than $500 million — its first round since Beijing ordered Meta's $2 billion acquisition unwound — co-led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital, with Tencent, HSG and ZhenFund.

item.title: Host your own ChatGPT: hands-on with Whirl, the open-source AI chat app
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Whirl (whirlchat/whirl, MIT) is the full production code behind whirl.chat — a Next.js 16 + Convex chat app that routes every top model through one conversation, keeps long-term memory, connects your tools over MCP, and edits living documents in a side panel. Roughly 500 GitHub stars in its first week. This walkthrough self-hosts it: clone, wire up Convex and Clerk, and switch on the extras.

item.title: USA Today sues OpenAI over AI training data: 160,000 articles in WebText, $250M sought
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: USA TODAY Co. sued OpenAI in federal court on October 8, 2026, alleging hundreds of thousands of its articles were scraped for AI training — including 160,000 entries in WebText — and seeking damages in excess of $250 million.

item.title: Magnific One: an image model that art-directs before it generates — with a Brand Kit that enforces your visual identity
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Magnific (formerly Freepik) launched Magnific One, an image model that settles art direction before rendering, with a Brand Kit that extracts your visual identity and checks every image against it.

item.title: Google Cloud launches the Gemini agent: a single universal agent for work — delegate objectives, get back finished work
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google Cloud has unveiled the Gemini agent, a single, universal agent for work announced today at Gemini at Work 2026. It takes objectives instead of instructions, picks the best model for each job — Gemini or Anthropic's Claude — and keeps working for hours or days across Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Slack.

item.title: Illumina launches SpliceAI2: genomic AI that predicts RNA splicing from DNA alone — and beats AlphaGenome on the benchmarks
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Illumina's BioInsight AI Lab has launched SpliceAI2, a genomic AI model that predicts how genetic variants alter RNA splicing from a DNA sequence alone — finding 17% more disease-relevant variants than rival models and outperforming Google DeepMind's AlphaGenome across three independent benchmarks.

item.title: TODAY lands €2.8M to scale AI agents that take the admin off financial advisors' desks
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Copenhagen-based TODAY raised €2.8M in seed funding co-led by HTGF and InsurTech Gateway to scale compliance-first AI agents for financial and insurance advisors — transcribing meetings, automating back-office work, and coaching sales — already used by 3,500+ advisors in the DACH region.

item.title: XPeng names its robotaxi YOYO: L4, vision-only, VLA 2.0 — public registration opens in China
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: XPeng officially named its robotaxi business ‘XPENG YOYO’ and opened public registration in China — the first step from 2,000 internal test rides toward driverless service in 2027, powered by four in-house Turing AI chips and the VLA 2.0 large model.

item.title: Stop re-explaining your project to Claude Code: hands-on with claude-mem
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: claude-mem (thedotmack/claude-mem, Apache-2.0) gives Claude Code persistent memory: lifecycle hooks capture every session into a local SQLite and vector store, and the next session wakes up already briefed. Install it, build some history, then query that memory when you need it.

item.title: ONLYOFFICE 10.0 ships AI inside every editor — plus free MCP-powered AI Agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: ONLYOFFICE 10.0 embeds context-aware AI tools directly into every editor — documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs — and ships four free modular apps, including MCP-powered AI Agents, all under AGPL v3.

item.title: Rein Security raises $25M: runtime security for the AI agents enterprises actually build
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Rein Security raised a $25 million Series A to secure the AI agents enterprises build in-house — runtime "sidecar" visibility into every line of code an agent executes, with real-time guardrails that block harmful actions before they complete.

item.title: Verso raises $6M: AI interviewers that build a living consumer knowledge base — for teams and agents alike
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: France-based Verso raised a $6 million seed round led by Angular Ventures to automate consumer research end to end — AI-moderated video interviews, automated analysis, and a queryable consumer knowledge base. Ferrero, Orange and Michelin are already customers.

item.title: Biren raises $515M in its third capital raise of 2026 to fund next-gen GPU production — and Hong Kong keeps saying yes
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Shanghai Biren Technology said on October 8 it will place 130 million new H-shares at HK$31.08 apiece, raising about HK$4.04 billion (~$515 million) — its third major raise of 2026. Investors have had three chances to say no this year; they haven't taken one.

item.title: Isomorphic Labs in funding talks at a $40B valuation: AI drug design gets a pharma-scale price tag
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Alphabet-backed Isomorphic Labs is in early talks to raise new funding at a valuation of at least $40 billion, Bloomberg reports — potentially $50 billion — just five months after its $2.1 billion Series B. The proposed price tests whether investors believe AI-designed drugs can survive contact with the clinic.

item.title: Confine an AI agent to one folder and one API: hands-on with Strands Box
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Strands Box (strands-agents/box, Apache-2.0) is an open-source sandbox engine for AI agents: operating-system isolation plus deny-by-default policies written in Dogwood. Install it, box the Strands CLI, watch it refuse a file write, then grant exactly that one permission.

item.title: Nuix ships a governed GenAI layer for legal AI: bring your own model, keep the audit trail
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Nuix launched the Nuix Neo Generative AI Framework on October 7: a governed orchestration layer that connects a customer's chosen LLM to forensically processed enterprise data — with audit-grade telemetry, policy guardrails, and token metering built for legal, risk, and investigation teams.

item.title: LlamaIndex launches OpenDocRouter: every document model under one API, priced at cost
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: LlamaIndex launched OpenDocRouter on October 7: one API behind 10 document-parsing models — five frontier, five open-source — each benchmarked on ParseBench for quality and cost, with provider token prices passed through at cost.

item.title: Stuut raises $52.5M: AI agents chase the $16 trillion sitting in unpaid invoices
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Stuut announced a $52.5 million Series B led by Insight Partners on October 7, bringing its total funding to $93 million — money to expand the AI agents it says run the entire order-to-cash process for enterprise customers, from missing purchase orders to paid invoices.
